summary: PTY launches resolve every working directory to a canonical absolute directory on the launching host before publication. Runtime inventory also finalizes ended producers after applied starts leave pending-start cleanup, without requiring a daemon restart.

schema.detail: No database or durable sidecar format changes.

rules.detail: A working directory must resolve to an existing directory before producer creation. Default personal terminals require an available host home directory; no relative fallback is forwarded.

compatibility.detail: Wire parameters and home-intent tags remain unchanged. Relative runtime workspaces retain daemon-relative semantics but are forwarded canonically. Existing conservative generation, boot, scope and launcher acknowledgement checks still govern closure.

downtime.detail: Updated runtime behavior takes effect after daemon restart.

manual.detail: No manual producer-record repair is performed or required for new launches.

recovery.detail: Ambiguous or live producers remain pending. Closure uses the existing durable idempotent closure record and publication_pending=false owner transition.
